metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins — adversarial review tooling that runs before code ships, and stack-specific agents that build what it reviews.

plugins.name: review-kit
plugins.description: Adversarial review tooling: attack a plan before it is built, rehearse a migration before it touches live data, and audit a running app against the accessibility tree and its own design system.

plugins.name: build-kit
plugins.description: Stack-specific implementation agents that carry their stack's traps: React on the client, Hono and Drizzle on the server.
